descriptionByLocale.en: Are you an experienced equity capital markets professional with deep Financial Institutions Group (FIG) expertise? We’re looking for somebody to join our ECM team to support origination and execution across FIG clients. In this role, you will: -originate, structure, and execute equity and equity-linked transactions for FIG clients (including IPOs, follow-ons, block trades, and convertibles) -partner closely with FIG coverage, syndicate, and sales teams to deliver integrated capital markets solutions -manage day-to-day execution processes, including coordination of internal and external stakeholders -develop and maintain senior client relationships across banks, insurers, asset managers, and specialty finance companies -contribute to strategic advisory discussions, including capital optimization, balance sheet management, and market positioning -mentor and develop junior team members

• - Partner eng mit der Erfassung, dem Syndikat und den Vertriebsteams von Fig.

• - Beitrag zu strategischen Beratungen, einschließlich Kapitaloptimierung, Bilanzmanagement und Marktpositionierung
